Row.Text: Turns every fix in this mod off without uninstalling it. This is the first thing to try if map tacks start misbehaving after a Detailed Map Tacks update.

Right-click a map tack on the map to delete it. Detailed Map Tacks on its own only deletes one on left-click, and only while the tack chooser is open. The click is swallowed, so it does not also order the selected unit to move there.
